data: Which algorithms are compared in this figure?

The figure compares the performance of three algorithms: Feudal-DQN, DIP-DQN, and DQN. Additionally, it includes GP-Sarsa as a reference point, which is mentioned in the caption. The caption also specifies that the comparison is made against the two best-performing algorithms from Casanueva et al. (2017), which are DQN and GPSarsa. Therefore, the algorithms compared in this figure are Feudal-DQN, DIP-DQN, DQN, and GPSarsa.
